article_manifest.title: Takalot, Talhandak and San: Several positions of terrorist groups struck down
article_manifest.original_title: Takalot, Talhandak et San : Plusieurs positions des groupes terroristes foudroyées
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, October 9 (AMAP)– The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) destroyed a vehicle containing war materiel northeast of Takalot and hit a major logistics point in the Talhandak area, as well as a base housing terrorist elements northeast of San, during air-land operations conducted Thursday, October 8 as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces .

article_manifest.title: Niger: France expels two intelligence agents, one suspected of monitoring opponents
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : la France expulse deux agents de renseignement, l'un soupçonné de surveiller des opposants
article_manifest.summary: Tensions between France and Niger have been building since 2023. France has expelled two agents of the Nigerien intelligence services, reveals Le Monde on October 8, citing a French diplomatic source and a Nigerien source. One of the expelled officers was suspected of carrying out surveillance activities targeting opponents of the Niamey authorities present on French soil .

article_manifest.title: Takalot, Talhandak, San: FAMa surgical offensive against terrorist strongholds in the North and Center
article_manifest.original_title: Takalot, Talhandak, San : Offensive chirurgicale des FAMa contre les bastions terroristes dans le Nord et le Centre
article_manifest.summary: Takalot, Talhandak, San: FAMa surgical offensive against terrorist strongholds in the North and the Centre The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced, in a statement, the continuation of the offensive in the Eastern Theater as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. New air-land interventions were conducted by the Malian Armed Forces and their partners on Thursday, October 8, 2026 .

article_manifest.title: Road safety: 700 vehicles impounded in one morning in Ouagadougou
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurité routière : 700 engins mis en fourrière en une matinée à Ouagadougou
article_manifest.summary: This Thursday, October 8, 2026, the Ouagadougou municipal police conducted a vast control operation on the roads of the capital. Between 6:00 am and 10:00 am, this descent focused on compliance with the mandatory helmet resulted in the impoundment of 700 two-wheeled vehicles and three tricycles . After a two-year nationwide awareness-raising period, municipal and security authorities have resolutely shifted to a phase of repression.

article_manifest.title: When the home becomes a place of death: the series of domestic violence in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Quand le foyer devient un lieu de mort : la série des violences conjugales au Mali
article_manifest.summary: The death of Racky Diaby, a young Malian presented in several recent publications as having been killed by her husband by firearms, brings to the fore a reality that is not new in Mali. Over the years, several women have lost their lives in their own homes, victims of violence committed by their spouses . Behind every case, there is a woman, a family and the same question: what to do when violence settles in a couple before it becomes irreversible?

article_manifest.title: Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city
article_manifest.original_title: Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city
article_manifest.summary: Recently published video is said to show Mali’s armed forces in Kidal after retaking the strategic northern city from Tuareg separatists. It would be a major symbolic gain for Mali’s military government, which lost the city to separatists six months ago.

article_manifest.title: No ransom paid for release of abducted corps members, says Imo CP
article_manifest.original_title: No ransom paid for release of abducted corps members, says Imo CP
article_manifest.summary: The Imo State Commissioner of Police, Audu Bosso, has said he is not aware of any ransom payment for the release of 20 prospective National Youth Service Corps members and a civilian abducted along the Owerri-Onitsha Road. The victims, who were abducted on October 1, 2026, were rescued from the Amokohia Uwe Forest in the Owerri West Local Government Area of the state after a coordinated operation by security agencies.

article_manifest.title: What Russia’s Africa Corps Is Actually Doing in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: What Russia’s Africa Corps Is Actually Doing in Mali
article_manifest.summary: - African Arguments, 7 October 2026 On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced.

article_manifest.title: KIDAL: The FAMa consolidate their operational system in the city
article_manifest.original_title: KIDAL : Les FAMa consolident leur dispositif opérationnel dans la ville
article_manifest.summary: As part of the large-scale offensive conducted in the Eastern Theater, as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, consolidated their operational system in the city of KIDAL This operation comes following a campaign of intense airstrikes and several air-land operations carried out over the last few days, which have made it possible to neutralize several elements belonging to the FLA-JNIM terrorist coalition, while dealing significant blows, in depth, to their logistical capacities and their means of action.

article_manifest.title: Drama in Faladié: A young bride shot dead, her husband taken into custody
article_manifest.original_title: Drame à Faladié : Une jeune mariée tuée par balle, son époux placé en garde à vue
article_manifest.summary: DRAMA IN FALADIÉ: A YOUNG BRIDE SHOT DEAD, HER HUSBAND ARRESTED barely a few days after her wedding, HARKIA was found dead in the marital chamber. A firearm was reportedly discovered at the home of her husband, who was taken into custody. The tragedy occurred on the night of Tuesday, October 6 to Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at about 3 a.m., in Faladié .

article_manifest.title: Malian army recaptures Kidal with Russian support.. 'Liberation of Azawad' vows to continue fighting
article_manifest.original_title: الجيش المالي يستعيد كيدال بدعم روسي.. و"تحرير أزواد" تتوعد بمواصلة القتال
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army regained control of the strategic city of Kidal in the north of the country, after the withdrawal of the Front for the Liberation of Azawad from it following extensive air and ground operations carried out by the Malian forces with the support of the Russian "African Legion", in a development that represents an important symbolic gain for the military government in Bamako, but it does not seem decisive for the course of the ongoing conflict in the north of the country.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Malian forces target supply networks in Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les forces maliennes ciblent les réseaux d’approvisionnement à Kidal
article_manifest.summary: As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their allies, have implemented several strategies to reduce the operational capabilities of opposing armed groups During the preparatory operations for the assault on Kidal, an active reconnaissance made it possible to identify several rear bases, storage facilities and fuel depots used by the armed groups.

article_manifest.title: Mali: after the takeover of Kidal, the FAMa launch a new operation
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : après la reprise de Kidal, les FAMa lancent une nouvelle opération
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by the Russian Africa Corps, are conducting a sweep operation in southern Kidal, after the city was retaken on October 6. According to the Africa Corps, armed combatants fled in a hurry as troops approached. Indeed, on October 6, the army entered the city of Kidal around 1 p.m., according to Malian security sources .

article_manifest.title: Me Mountaga Tall: we don't talk about it anymore?
article_manifest.original_title: Me Mountaga Tall : on n’en parle plus ?
article_manifest.summary: Five months after his alleged abduction, the silence around the fate of Me Mountaga Tall seems to settle. A situation that worries relatives, relatives and even human rights organizations. The name of Me Mountaga Tall, once very present in the debate and on social networks, seems to be gradually disappearing from the news.

article_manifest.title: PANDEF mourns victims of Ondo Air Force crash, seeks probe
article_manifest.original_title: PANDEF mourns victims of Ondo Air Force crash, seeks probe
article_manifest.summary: By Henry Umoru ABUJA — The Pan Niger Delta Forum (PANDEF), the apex socio-political body of the South-South geopolitical zone, has mourned the victims of the Nigerian Air Force (NAF) aircraft crash in the Igbokoda area of Ilaje Local Government Area of Ondo State. PANDEF also called for a thorough and comprehensive investigation to determine the circumstances that may have contributed to the crash and similar aviation tragedies.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Allied Mali-Russian forces thwart terrorist ambushes on the outskirts of Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko: Les forces alliées Mali-Russie déjouent des embuscades terroristes aux abords de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: During their advance on Kidal, the joint units of Mali and Russia neutralized several ambush threats during reconnaissance patrols on the outskirts of the city. Several ambush locations were thus identified by the reconnaissance teams . According to the information gathered, the mission assigned to these terrorist groups was to delay the advance of the allied forces while the main forces of the terrorist coalition formed by the Fla (Frame for the Liberation of Azawad) and the JNIM (Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims) withdrew from Kidal.

article_manifest.title: The Nigerien Armed Forces sensitized on the general mobilization
article_manifest.original_title: Les Forces Armées Nigériennes sensibilisées sur la mobilisation générale
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 08 Oct(ANP)- The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani KIAOU chaired, on Wednesday, October 07, 2026 at the Palais des Congrès in Niamey, an exchange meeting with the Commission responsible for the organization, preparation and monitoring of the implementation of the General Mobilization (COMOG) .

article_manifest.title: Mali: A return in trompe-l'oeil of the Fama in Kidal?
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Un retour en trompe-l'oeil des Fama à Kidal ?
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army and its Africa Corps allies announced that they had reinvested Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The Fla (Azawad Liberation Front) and the Jnim (Support Group for Islam and Muslims) claim a tactical withdrawal to preserve the populations. Some think that this return bears the mark of Algiers.

article_manifest.title: Diffa/Goudoumaria: 250 t of millet for targeted free distribution in 104 villages
article_manifest.original_title: Diffa/Goudoumaria : 250 t de mil pour une distribution gratuite ciblée dans 104 villages
article_manifest.summary: Le Sahel.org

article_manifest.title: Kéniéba: An international network for money laundering and trafficking in cultural property dismantled
article_manifest.original_title: Kéniéba : Un réseau international de blanchiment d’argent et de trafic de biens culturels démantelé
article_manifest.summary: The Keniéba Gendarmerie Brigade recently arrested a young man from Faléa, Kéniéba commune, Kayes region, involved in an alleged international network of money laundering and trafficking in cultural property. The operation led to the seizure of 3 carved doors of great heritage value, which were allegedly stolen from Dékon, in the Bandiagara region, and intended for export to the West Source: L’Indicateur du Renouveau, Mali

article_manifest.title: Me Mountaga Tall: we don't talk about it anymore?

The name of Me Mountaga Tall, once very present in the debate and on social networks, seems to be gradually disappearing from the news .

article_manifest.title: Military justice: Bamako Court sentences military and civilians for arms trafficking
article_manifest.original_title: Justice militaire : Le Tribunal de Bamako condamne des militaires et civils pour trafic d'armes
article_manifest.summary: Military justice: The Court of Bamako convicts military and civilians for arms trafficking The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, its ordinary correctional hearing, presided over by Magistrate Assama Dolo. Five cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for serious acts related to weapons and military discipline .

article_manifest.title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
article_manifest.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory -- it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

article_manifest.title: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maiga and his men at the heart of the FAMa's takeover and securing of the city

article_manifest.title: Militant spillover from Mali raises mining-related security risks in Guinea
article_manifest.original_title: Militant spillover from Mali raises mining-related security risks in Guinea
article_manifest.summary: Executive summary Guinea has remained largely insulated from the militant violence affecting neighboring Mali. However, the security environment along the Mali-Guinea border has become increasingly fragile as the al-Qaeda-affiliated Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) has expanded and entrenched its presence across southern Mali. This expansion has brought militant activity closer to Guinea’s eastern border areas, where major industrial and artisanal mining sites are located.

article_manifest.title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
article_manifest.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory -- it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

article_manifest.summary: In Mali, the junta of General Goïta managed yesterday Tuesday to recapture the city of Kidal, which it had lost six months ago to the Tuareg rebels of the Fla, the Azawad Liberation Front. The Malian Armed Forces and their Russian allies entered the large city in the far north of the country without a fight yesterday afternoon. Is this the end of the war?

article_manifest.title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
article_manifest.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting.

article_manifest.title: Kidal: the Malian army regains control of the city
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : l’armée malienne reprend le contrôle de la ville
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army regained control of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, October 6. The Malian Armed Forces entered the city without resistance. This return comes more than five months after the capture of Kidal by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), allied to the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) Several security sources confirm this entry of the Fama into Kidal.

article_manifest.title: Mali’s army says it has taken Kidal from Tuareg rebels, with Russia’s help
article_manifest.original_title: Mali’s army says it has taken Kidal from Tuareg rebels, with Russia’s help
article_manifest.summary: Mali’s armed forces have entered the strategic northern city of Kidal, five months after separatist rebels seized it, following an air and ground campaign backed by Russia’s Africa Corps. In a statement carried by state television on Tuesday, Mali’s transitional government said troops had “consolidated their positions” in the city, “supported by their Russian partners”.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso Opens First Gold Refinery
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso Opens First Gold Refinery
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso has opened its first gold refinery as the West African country seeks to strengthen state control over the commercialisation of its mineral resources and reduce gold smuggling. The country is Africa’s third-largest gold producer, producing more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal in 2025, according to the World Gold Council. Authorities have struggled to regulate informal gold mining, a sector affected by smuggling and jihadist violence.

article_manifest.title: Securing the national territory: the FAMa are strengthening their system in Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurisation du territoire national : les FAMa renforcent leur dispositif à Kidal
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, Oct 6 (AMAP)- The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, strengthened and consolidated their operations in Kidal on Tuesday, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the government announced in a statement issued today. According to the document, this reinforcement follows "intense air-land neutralization operations" carried out against a coalition of terrorist groups .

article_manifest.title: Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO: The FAMa and their Russian partners intensify the offensive in the Eastern and Central theaters
article_manifest.original_title: Opération DOUGOUKOLOKO : Les FAMa et leurs partenaires russes intensifient l’offensive dans les théâtres Est et Centre
article_manifest.summary: In line with its previous communiqué, the General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, are continuing the large-scale offensive launched on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 in the Eastern Theater, as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO . This operation aims in particular to strengthen the security of the populations living in this part of the national territory, to guarantee the free movement of people and goods, to secure the borders and to stop the criminal economy developed by the armed terrorist groups (GAT) .

article_manifest.title: Kidal, Timbuktu, Sofara: Massive FAMa offensive against terrorist strongholds in the North and Centre
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal, Tombouctou, Sofara : Offensive massive des FAMa contre les bastions terroristes dans le Nord et le Centre
article_manifest.summary: By a new communiqué, the General Staff of the Armed Forces confirmed the continuation of the major offensive started on 6 October 2026 in the Eastern zone, as a continuation of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, carried out simultaneous strikes on several sectors of the country. This operation aims in particular to strengthen the security of the populations living in this part of the national territory, to guarantee the free movement of people and goods, to secure the borders and to stop the criminal economy developed by armed terrorist groups (GAT).

article_manifest.title: Aguelhoc: nearly 8,000 displaced people and host families benefit from WFP food stamps
article_manifest.original_title: Aguelhoc : près de 8 000 déplacés et familles d’accueil bénéficient de coupons alimentaires du PAM
article_manifest.summary: In Aguelhoc, in the Kidal region, the food situation remains a concern for displaced people and host families. To respond to the emergency, the World Food Programme (WFP), with the support of its partners, launched a food voucher distribution operation in early September. Nearly 8,000 people, or about 1,500 households, benefited from this first phase .

article_manifest.title: Mali: Fla withdraws from Kidal and leaves the field open to the army
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: le FLA se retire de Kidal et laisse le champ libre à l'armée
article_manifest.summary: About 120 vehicles came out of Aéfis, Mali, in the middle of the morning. On board, Malian soldiers, Russian soldiers from the Africa Corps, and fighters from the MSA and Gatia, Tuareg political-military groups integrated into the Malian army (Fama) In a statement issued at midday this Tuesday, the General Staff claims for the first time "to have launched large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region", with its "Russian partners", in order to "neutralize the armed terrorist groups", "destroy their sanctuaries" and "permanently restore the security of the populations" and their "free movement".

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa intensify their operations in Kidal, Abéïbara, Tin-Assalak and In-Tassik
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa intensifient leurs opérations à Kidal, Abéïbara, Tin-Assalak et In-Tassik
article_manifest.summary: From Kidal to Abéïbara, the Malian Armed Forces continue their air-land operations against armed terrorist groups The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) continue their mission with determination as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO . After the launch of this new operational phase on Monday, October 5, 2026 in the Eastern Theater, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported on new actions carried out in several sectors of the north and center of the country .

article_manifest.title: Mali.. The army announces the entry of the city of Kidal after the withdrawal of the "Front for the Liberation of Azawad"
article_manifest.original_title: مالي.. الجيش يعلن دخول مدينة كيدال بعد انسحاب "جبهة تحرير أزواد"
article_manifest.summary: On Tuesday, the Malian army announced its entry into the strategic city of Kidal in the north of the country, following the announcement of the "Front for the Liberation of Azawad" to withdraw from it, about six months after the Front took control of it. AFP quoted a Malian officer as confirming the entry of elements of the Kidal army without facing any resistance, while another indicated that the army arrived in the city "ahead of schedule" .

This offensive aims to "track down and neutralize armed terrorist groups operating throughout the region, destroy their sanctuaries and supply networks and restore lasting security to the populations and the free movement of people and goods" .

article_manifest.title: Generative AI Alters the Battlefield in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Generative AI Alters the Battlefield in Mali
article_manifest.summary: There is an information war being fought in Mali online and on social media platforms. A new study outlines how generative artificial intelligence is being used by state, nonstate and foreign entities to push propaganda and misinformation. A September 9 report by the Dakar-based Timbuktu Institute, titled “Algorithms at War: How Generative AI is Reshaping the Malian Conflict,” examined al-Qaida affiliate Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), the Malian government, Russia’s Africa Corps and the Tuareg separatist group Azawad Liberation Front (FLA).

Cette reprise de Kidal, bastion de la rébellion, représente une victoire pour l’armée malienne, qui en avait été chassée en avril par le Front de libération de l’Azawad (FLA) et ses alliés djihadistes du Groupe de soutien à l’islam et aux musulmans (JNIM), affilié à Al-Qaida.

article_manifest.title: AES: how jihadists learned to strike with drones
article_manifest.original_title: AES : comment les djihadistes ont appris à frapper avec des drones
article_manifest.summary: JNIM, a jihadist group linked to Al-Qaeda, claimed responsibility for an ambush on 28 September 2026 against a convoy of the Malian army and the Russian Africa Corps, near Niono, in central Mali. Drone fire opened the attack before the ground assault, and at least four Russians were killed according to local sources . This is clearly an evolution that the armies of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), which brings together Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, have not been able to stop: in three years, armed groups in the region have gone from simple reconnaissance drones to strike weapons.

article_manifest.title: Algeria: President Tebboune discusses relations with Niger and Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Algérie : Le président Tebboune évoque les relations avec le Niger et le Mali
article_manifest.summary: Members of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), Niger and Mali have warmed up their relations with Algeria after the Tinzaouatène incident in April 2025. Niamey leads several projects with Algiers in areas such as mining, energy, etc. In his periodic interview broadcast on Saturday, October 3 on Algerian television channels, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune said that his country supports the development of Niger.

article_manifest.title: Mali's military offensive has begun in the Kidal region
article_manifest.original_title: L’offensive militaire malienne a commencé dans la région de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: Malian social networks favorable to the regime relayed Monday images, filmed the same day, of drone strikes on the city of Tinzawaten, on the Algerian border. These strikes herald the start of the offensive to recapture Kidal and the northern region that was announced for the end of the rainy season . Tinzawaten was until now a military sanctuary of the Azawad Liberation Front, the main target of the offensive to reconquer the north.

article_manifest.title: Burkina: decrease in road accidents in August and September
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina : baisse des accidents de la route en août et septembre
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso recorded a decline in traffic accidents, injuries and fatalities in August and September 2026, with the lowest monthly levels of the year, according to Ministry of Security statistics released Monday. In September, 1,450 accidents were recorded, resulting in 1,055 injuries and 69 deaths, compared to 1,516 accidents, 1,347 injuries and 79 deaths in August In the first nine months of 2026, the country recorded 15,853 traffic accidents, resulting in 12,858 injuries and 910 deaths, the ministry said.

article_manifest.title: Article reserved for subscribers Analysis. In the Sahel, Algeria has emerged from its doctrine of non-intervention Middle East Eye

article_manifest.summary: At the request of the Nigerien authorities, Algeria announced, on August 30, the deployment of four Su-30 fighters, a tanker plane and a transport plane to help its neighbor. This support mission was launched in the aftermath of an abortive coup in Niger, a country led by General Abdourahamane Tiani since his own coup in July 2023. The country, which shares a 950-kilometre border with southern Algeria, is shaken by renewed tensions.

article_manifest.summary: A serious traffic accident occurred on Saturday, October 3, 2026 on National Road 6 (RN6), on the Bla-San axis. A bus of the company "Guissé Trans", from Gouma to Bamako, overturned while carrying 65 passengers and livestock .

article_manifest.title: San: Army fends off attack despite casualties
article_manifest.original_title: San : l’armée repousse une attaque malgré des pertes
article_manifest.summary: An attack was perpetrated Sunday, August 9 against the grip of the 23rd San Infantry Regiment. The General Staff of the Armed Forces claims to have regained control of the camp after fighting that resulted in casualties in the military ranks and among the attackers According to the statement issued Monday, August 10, the attack began around 5:30 a.m. and mobilized heavy machine guns, kamikaze drones, charge-dropping drones as well as two armored vehicles.

article_manifest.title: Under FAMa fire: Several terrorist logistics bases destroyed in Tessalit, Nampala and Sofara
article_manifest.original_title: Sous le feu des FAMa : Plusieurs bases logistiques terroristes détruites à Tessalit, Nampala et Sofara
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their permanent operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Wednesday, September 30, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, in the immediate outskirts of Tessalit, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war and logistics equipment.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa destroy a terrorist base with armed vehicles south of Koutiala
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : Les FAMa détruisent une base terroriste avec véhicules armés au sud de Koutiala
article_manifest.summary: In a statement, the General Staff of the Armed Forces said that the operations to secure the territory, carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, are continuing. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted a new targeted strike on Saturday, October 3, 2026 On Saturday, October 3, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, several points of entrenchment of armed terrorist groups.

article_manifest.title: Koutiala: Neutralization of terrorist shelters and armed vehicles by FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Koutiala : Neutralisation de refuges terroristes et de véhicules armés par les FAMa
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their permanent operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Saturday, October 3, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war materials including many armed vehicles.

article_manifest.title: Kidal: six wounded evacuated to Gao, the Fla speaks of released soldiers
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : six blessés évacués à Gao, le FLA parle de militaires libérés
article_manifest.summary: AT this TIME The International Committee of the Red Cross specifies that it organized this evacuation after obtaining security guarantees from all parties to the conflict. Its press release does not give the identity of the persons transferred and does not specify their status. This discretion corresponds to his mandate as a neutral intermediary and the confidential nature of his dialogue with the belligerents On the same day, the Azawad Liberation Front announced that it had entrusted six wounded Malian soldiers, captured in previous clashes, to the ICRC.

article_manifest.title: Niger: the mutiny that targeted the heart of power
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : la mutinerie qui a visé le cœur du pouvoir
article_manifest.summary: RIGHT NOW The events of August 29th go far beyond a barracks protest. They establish an armed mutiny directed against several strategic sites, but the public elements do not yet allow to reconstitute an organized project of seizure of power Three days after the shots that shook Niamey, the Nigerien authorities are once again in control of Air Base 101, Diori-Hamani International Airport, the presidential palace and the other targeted sites.

article_manifest.title: Targeted financial sanctions: Bamako expands its security pressure tool
article_manifest.original_title: Sanctions financières ciblées : Bamako élargit son outil de pression sécuritaire
article_manifest.summary: AT THIS TIME The text provides for the freezing of the property and economic resources of the persons concerned for six renewable months. It is based on national texts relating to the fight against money laundering, the financing of terrorism and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction . The grievances are formulated identically for the twelve names: alleged support for JNIM and the Azawad Liberation Front, promotion or apology of terrorism, criminal association and facilitation of terrorist acts.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: the Regional Security Council examines the security situation and recommends strengthening the existing system
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : le Conseil Régional de Sécurité examine la situation sécuritaire et recommande un renforcement du dispositif existant
article_manifest.summary: The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired, on Wednesday, March 11, 2026, the regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS), held in the usual meeting room in the Governorate of Agadez . This meeting allowed the members of this forum to examine the security situation in the region and identify the measures necessary to strengthen the protection of populations and their property.

article_manifest.title: BAMEX 2025: A strategic strengthening of military cooperation in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: BAMEX 2025 : Un renforcement stratégique de la coopération militaire au Mali
article_manifest.summary: This exhibition, which takes place in two phases, began with an exhibition at the Bamako Exhibition Park and continues with practical demonstrations at the Boubacar Sada Sy Center in Koulikoro. It offers a unique opportunity to discover state-of-the-art equipment, presented by more than 30 international companies, mainly Turkish, but also Russian and Chinese .

article_manifest.title: FAMa: positions of armed groups targeted in Abéïbara and near Sévaré
article_manifest.original_title: FAMa : des positions de groupes armés ciblées à Abéïbara et près de Sévaré
article_manifest.summary: AT THIS MOMENT The Malian army continues its air operations against the armed groups active in the country. In a statement issued Wednesday, August 26, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported a series of strikes in the north and center of Mali, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the military hierarchy, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible, on Monday, August 24, to locate several regroupment points of armed terrorist groups in Abéïbara, in the Kidal region.

article_manifest.title: 65th anniversary of the Malian Army: the nation pays tribute to its forces
article_manifest.original_title: 65ᵉ anniversaire de l’Armée malienne : la nation rend hommage à ses forces
article_manifest.summary: Mali commemorated this Tuesday the 65th anniversary of the creation of its national army, on the occasion of an official ceremony presided over by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces .

article_manifest.title: In Mali, from the Wagner Group to Africa Corps, the continuity of impunity?
article_manifest.original_title: Au Mali, du groupe Wagner à Africa Corps, la continuité de l’impunité ?
article_manifest.summary: The transfer of Wagner's mercenaries to the military of Africa Corps, two Russian organizations, did not put an end to the abuses against civilians.

article_manifest.title: Senou: A dangerous network of inoperable motorcycle robbers
article_manifest.original_title: Sénou : Un dangereux réseau de braqueurs de motos hors d’état de nuire
article_manifest.summary: FIGHT AGAINST DELINQUENCY and CRIME: As part of the strengthening of security, the Senou Police Station, headed by Chief Police Commissioner Cheickna SOW, arrested three (03) individuals suspected of being members of a criminal network on 19 September 2026 The operation, carried out by the Research Brigade, follows the denunciation of several cases of motorcycle theft in the peripheral districts of Bamako and the surrounding localities, sometimes followed by robberies.

article_manifest.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
article_manifest.original_title: 6 Burkina Faso: Nuit de la Révolution progressiste populaire - Les principaux acquis présentés à la population
article_manifest.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: Seizure of a significant amount of cocaine estimated at more than 2.5 billion CFA francs
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Saisie d’une importante quantité de cocaïne estimée à plus de 2,5 milliards F CFA
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, Sept 29 (ANP) – The defense and security forces have successfully seized a significant amount of cocaine in the Agadez region. With an estimated value of 2,570,610,000 CFA francs, this seizure was presented to the press on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 at the Regional Directorate of the National Police .

article_manifest.title: Mali: Evidence of War Crimes
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Evidence of War Crimes
article_manifest.summary: Members of Mali’s armed forces working together with personnel from the Wagner Group committed war crimes, including the murder and torture of civilians, during joint operations between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: more than 50 kg of cocaine and other narcotics seized in Arlit
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : plus de 50 kg de cocaïne et d’autres stupéfiants saisis à Arlit
article_manifest.summary: The National Gendarmerie intercepted more than 50 kilograms of cocaine as well as other narcotic products during a security operation conducted in the department of Arlit. The market value of the seized drug is estimated at more than two billion CFA francs. The products were handed over to the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez .

article_manifest.title: 29 September 2026 - 14:21 Ouagadougou: a cannabis trafficking network dismantled, 86 kg seized
article_manifest.original_title: 29 septembre 2026 - 14:21 Ouagadougou : un réseau de trafic de cannabis démantelé, 86 kg saisis
article_manifest.summary: The Anti-Drug Unit of the Judicial Police Directorate has put an end to the activities of a cannabis trafficking and sales network in Ouagadougou. This structured group also engaged in the sale of adulterated beverages, contraband cigarettes and psychotropic products. According to the police, the goods were transported from a neighboring country, by public or personal transport vehicles .

article_manifest.title: Mali: Report Accuses Army and Wagner of War Crimes
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Un rapport accuse l'armée et Wagner de crimes de guerre
article_manifest.summary: - Civilians killed in joint military operations - Civilians tortured to death in detention; others beaten, simulated drowning and electrocuted - Fulani, Arabs and Tuaregs targeted Members of the Malian armed forces acting with members of the Wagner group committed war crimes, including killings and torture of civilians during operations carried out between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

article_manifest.summary: New York, September 28, 2026 Mr. President, Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen, I have the great honor to carry, from this rostrum, the voice of Their Excellencies Comrade Captain Ibrahim TRAORÉ, President of Faso, Head of State and President of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES); Army General Assimi GOITA President of the Transition, Head of State of the Republic of Mali and Army General Abdourahamane TIANI, President of the Republic of Niger, Head of State.

article_manifest.original_title: Niger : après la mutinerie, Tiani resserre son emprise sur l…
article_manifest.summary: Sacré-Coeur 3 – BP 15177 CP 10700 Dakar Fann – SENEGAL. +221 33 827 34 91 / +221 77 637 73 15 contact@timbuktu-institute.org Timbuktu Institute - Week 3 September 2026 Niger faced one of its first internal challenges since the arrival of General Abdourahamane Tiani in power in 2023 with the coup attempt at the end of August 2026 . With the support of Africa Corps, the Nigerien army managed to regain control of strategic sites very quickly.

article_manifest.title: Crash of the Air Algérie flight AH5017 in Mali, the judgment expected in Paris
article_manifest.original_title: Crash du vol Air Algérie AH5017 au Mali, le jugement attendu à Paris
article_manifest.summary: Twelve years after the crash of Air Algérie flight AH5017, judgment is expected on Monday, September 28, 2026 in Paris. The aircraft, operated by the Spanish company Swiftair and chartered by Air Algérie, crashed on 24 July 2014 near Gossi, in the Timbuktu region. All 116 people on board, including a Malian, had perished.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: Ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS)
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Réunion ordinaire du Conseil Régional de Sécurité (CRS)
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, Sept. 24 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS). Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region .

article_manifest.title: Pregabalin trafficking in Agadez: Two individuals arrested, 6,900 capsules seized by OCRTIS
article_manifest.original_title: Trafic de prégabaline à Agadez : Deux individus interpellés, 6 900 gélules saisies par l’OCRTIS
article_manifest.summary: On 22 September 2026, the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez arrested two individuals suspected of being involved in pregabalin trafficking. The operation resulted in the seizure of 6,900 capsules of this highly risky substance, discovered in the hands of the first suspect and at the home of the second .

article_manifest.summary: The Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCTC), in collaboration with the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), closed this Friday, October 2, 2026, a training session devoted to the analysis of extremist and hate speech in digital media . article_manifest.title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
article_manifest.original_title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
article_manifest.summary: Algeria’s President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has said that his country sent fighter jets to Niger in late August to help thwart a “coup attempt” that shook the capital, Niamey. The confirmation came in excerpts from Tebboune’s interview with local media outlets that was broadcast on Saturday ahead of its full release.

article_manifest.original_title: رئيس الجزائر يكشف كواليس إرسال مقاتلات لإحباط محاولة انقلاب فى النيجر
article_manifest.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune revealed that his country sent fighter jets to Niger at the end of last August to thwart a coup attempt, stressing that his country's military move came in response to "provocations" to Algeria. In excerpts from an interview Tebboune gave to local media, the Algerian president explained that his Nigerian counterpart Mohamed Lamine Zine was on a visit to the country, and returned at night to his country, before a coup attempt took place.

article_manifest.summary: The Director of the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow, recalled the role of the media in the prevention of hate speech and violent extremism, on the occasion of the closing of the training organized by the Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCT) . According to the Director of DIRPA, the IMCT is an alliance of 43 states with a common Muslim religion, which are committed to organizing against terrorism and violent extremism in their regions .

article_manifest.title: Supply: A convoy of 643 tanker trucks arrives in Bamako under military escort
article_manifest.original_title: Approvisionnement : Un convoi de 643 camions-citernes arrive à Bamako sous escorte militaire
article_manifest.summary: A large convoy of more than 643 tanker trucks entered the Malian capital this Saturday, October 3, 2026, at around 7 a.m., after a night escort provided by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) . The convoy advanced all night under the protection of the military, kilometer after kilometer, before reaching Bamako at dawn. This operation is part of the continuous strengthening of the supply of petroleum products on the national territory .

article_manifest.title: Coup in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention
article_manifest.original_title: Coup d'état au Niger : L’Algérie dénonce une "provocation" et révèle son intervention militaire
article_manifest.summary: Coup d 'état in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention The Algerian President, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, strongly reaffirmed his country's unconditional support for Niger. During his regular meeting with the national press, the Head of State unveiled unprecedented details on Algiers' reaction to the recent coup attempt, described as an act of major destabilization .

article_manifest.title: Government exhibition The minister in charge of war, Célestin Simporé, exchanges with citizens
article_manifest.original_title: Exposition gouvernementale Le ministre chargé de la guerre, Célestin Simporé échange avec les citoyens
article_manifest.summary: The Minister of State, Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé, moderated the first session of the "Dialogue with the People" on the theme "Governance, National Security: The Standing People Account to You", Friday, October 2, 2026, at the SIAO . The Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé lent himself to an exercise of government accountability to the people on Friday, October 2, 2026 at the SIAO .

article_manifest.title: Mali: Arrival in Bamako of an exceptional convoy of more than 643 tankers under military escort
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Arrivée à Bamako d’un convoi exceptionnel de plus de 643 camions-citernes sous escorte militaire
article_manifest.summary: While Bamako slept, a long column of tankers advanced into the night, under the watchful protection of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). Kilometre after kilometre, our soldiers watched over each vehicle. This Saturday, October 3, 2026, around 7 a.m., at daybreak, more than 643 tankers entered the capital.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso's military leaders mark four years in power
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso's military leaders mark four years in power
article_manifest.summary: People gathered in Ougadougou’s Place de la Révolution on Wednesday night to mark four years since Captain Ibrahim Traoré came to power in a coup. The culmination of anniversary celebrations, they paid tribute to the armed forces and the military government’s achievements in Burkina Faso. One resident, Abdoul Rasmané Sawadogo, said military leaders have created an “ultra-modern army that meets expectations”.

article_manifest.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
article_manifest.original_title: 6 Burkina Faso: Nuit de la Révolution progressiste populaire - Les principaux acquis présentés à la population
article_manifest.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

article_manifest.title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
article_manifest.summary: Mali's new school year began Thursday with more than 2,400 schools unable to reopen, as worsening insecurity and the growing presence of jihadist groups continue to disrupt education. The 2026-2027 academic year has been declared the “Year of Education and Culture” by President Assimi Goïta, but thousands of children are starting the year without access to their classrooms.

article_manifest.title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
article_manifest.original_title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso has inaugurated its first gold refinery as its military-led government seeks to strengthen economic sovereignty after breaking ties with its traditional Western partners. “From now on, Burkina Faso’s gold must not only be mined in Burkina Faso; it must also be processed, controlled, valued and certified there,” President Ibrahim Traoré said on Monday at the inauguration of the refinery, named Raffinor-BF.

article_manifest.title: Crash of the Ouagadougou-Alger flight: Swiftair condemned
article_manifest.original_title: Crash du vol Ouagadougou-Alger: Swiftair condamnée
article_manifest.summary: The families of the victims had to wait twelve years. Gathered within the association "AH-5017 Ensemble", they led a "relentless fight for truth and justice" which is now experiencing its judicial outcome. The Spanish company Swiftair is found guilty of manslaughter this Monday morning by the Paris Criminal Court .

article_manifest.title: Crash of the Air Algérie flight AH5017 in Mali, the judgment expected in Paris
article_manifest.original_title: Crash du vol Air Algérie AH5017 au Mali, le jugement attendu à Paris
article_manifest.summary: Twelve years after the crash of Air Algérie flight AH5017, judgment is expected on Monday, September 28, 2026 in Paris. The aircraft, operated by the Spanish company Swiftair and chartered by Air Algérie, crashed on 24 July 2014 near Gossi, in the Timbuktu region. All 116 people on board, including a Malian, had perished.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: Ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS)
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Réunion ordinaire du Conseil Régional de Sécurité (CRS)
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, Sept. 24 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS). Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region .

article_manifest.title: Niger Coup: Survival of the Military Regime and Growing Fragility
article_manifest.original_title: Niger Coup: Survival of the Military Regime and Growing Fragility
article_manifest.summary: The attempted coup in Niamey on the night of 28–29 August 2026 exposed a fundamental contradiction at the heart of General Abdourahamane Tiani’s rule. Although the regime survived its serious internal challenge since the July 2023 coup against Mohamed Bazoum, the episode revealed fractures within the armed forces, declining confidence in the government’s ability to improve security, and dependence on foreign military support.

article_manifest.title: Protection of asins, camels and horses in Burkina Faso: A new framework to better fight against trafficking
article_manifest.original_title: Protection des asins, camelins et équins au Burkina Faso : Un nouveau cadre pour mieux lutter contre le trafic
article_manifest.summary: The Directorate General of Veterinary Services (DGSV) organized, on October 2, 2026 in Ouagadougou, a workshop dedicated to the popularization of the new regulatory framework for asins, camels and horses . Administrative, religious and customary authorities, veterinary services, customs, defence and security forces, VDP and breeders' representatives took part in the meeting to take ownership of the new provisions and strengthen their application on the ground .

article_manifest.title: ARMY MUSEUM: the School of Application and Development of Officers to discover the military heritage of our country
article_manifest.original_title: MUSÉE DES ARMÉES : l’École d’Application et de Perfectionnement des Officiers à la découverte du patrimoine militaire de notre pays
article_manifest.summary: The Army Museum welcomed, this Friday, October 2, 2026, a delegation from the School of Application and Development of Officers (EAPO), as part of the educational activities of the institution. The purpose of this visit was to allow the trainees to learn more about the military history of Mali and to immerse themselves in the immense heritage bequeathed by previous generations of Malian combatants .

article_manifest.title: Tribute ceremony to Thomas Sankara: Minister Mathias Traoré invites the Burkinabe to preserve the legacy of the national hero
article_manifest.original_title: Cérémonial d’hommage à Thomas Sankara : Le ministre Mathias Traoré invite les Burkinabè à préserver l’héritage du héros national
article_manifest.summary: The authorities gathered at the foot of the statue of Thomas Sankara. The Thomas Sankara Memorial hosted, this Thursday, October 1, 2026 in Ouagadougou, the military ceremony in tribute to Captain Thomas Sankara and his twelve companions, who fell on October 15, 1987 The ceremony brought together several members of the government as well as representatives of international organizations, who came to pay tribute to the memory of the former president of Faso and to recall the scope of his legacy.

article_manifest.title: Celebration of the 66th anniversary of the Malian Army
article_manifest.original_title: Célébration du 66ᵉ anniversaire de l’Armée de Terre malienne
article_manifest.summary: On October 1, 2026, the Malian Army celebrated its 66th anniversary in Djicoroni-Para, under the theme: "The Army, 66 years in the service of the Nation: cohesion and resilience for the sovereign defense of Mali" . Composed in particular of the Infantry, the Artillery and the Armoured Weapon and Cavalry, the Army constitutes the main pillar of the land defence of the country.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso opens first gold refinery in push for economic independence
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso opens first gold refinery in push for economic independence
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso opened its first gold refinery on Monday, pushing ahead with plans to better organise the commercialisation of the precious metal in one of the continent's top producers. The west African nation is the continent's third leading gold producer, churning out more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal last year, according to the World Gold Council. But authorities traditionally struggle to control the informal gold mining sector, which has been blighted by jihadist violence and smuggling.

From now on, the control of motor tricycles will be permanent to track down infringementists . article_manifest.summary: The land component of the Malian Armed Forces, the Army, celebrated the 66th anniversary of its creation on Thursday, October 1, 2026. The event was held on the grounds of the dojo of the 33rd Regiment of Parachute Commandos, in Djicoroni-Para, under the theme: "The Army, 66 years in the service of the Nation: cohesion and resilience for the sovereign defense of Mali" .

article_manifest.summary: The Association of Women Customs Officers and Wives of Customs Officers (AFDEM) organized, on Thursday, October 1, 2026, a blood donation day for the benefit of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), in the courtyard of the Malian Customs Office 205 in Faladiè. The ceremony was presided over by the Regional Director of Bamako Customs, Colonel Issiaka TANOU . This initiative recorded the participation of several components of the Defence and Security Forces.

article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : Les FAMa pilonnent des repaires terroristes à Tessalit, Nampala et Sofara
article_manifest.summary: The military command said, via a statement on Thursday, October 1, that the country's security missions are continuing as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted three targeted airstrikes on 30 September and 1 October 2026 . On Wednesday, 30 September, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, in the immediate outskirts of Tessalit, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war and logistics equipment.

article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso Holds Rally to Mark Traore Coup Anniversary
article_manifest.summary: Thousands of supporters of Burkina Faso’s military government gathered overnight in the capital, Ouagadougou, and other parts of the country to mark the fourth anniversary of the coup that brought Captain Ibrahim Traore to power. The rally, organised at the initiative of the junta, began at 6 pm on Wednesday and was described by organisers as a vigil celebrating Traore’s “Popular Progressive Revolution”.

article_manifest.summary: A few days before the start of the school year, scheduled for 1 October in Mali, displaced families face many obstacles to ensuring the schooling of their children. In Mopti as in Bamako, accommodation difficulties, lack of financial means and uncertainties related to enrolment complicate the resumption of courses . In Mopti, several families who fled the attack on the village of Kouakrou, in the Djenné circle, found refuge in the Djénédaga school.

article_manifest.summary: Captain Ibrahim Traoré has now led Burkina Faso for four years, the same length of time Thomas Sankara was in power. Both came to power as young, red-beret-wearing army captains, promising national sovereignty, Pan-Africanism and greater economic independence. Sankara, who seized power in 1983, launched what he called a “democratic and popular revolution,” promoting education, women’s empowerment, self-reliance and local production.

article_manifest.title: 5 Burkina Faso: The President of Faso, Captain Ibrahim Traoré - "In 4 years, the country is doing better"
article_manifest.original_title: 5 Burkina Faso: Le Président du Faso, capitaine Ibrahim Traoré - « En 4 ans, le pays se porte mieux »
article_manifest.summary: In front of journalists, yesterday Sunday, September 27, 2026, the President of Faso, Captain Ibrahim Traoré, a few days before the anniversary of his accession to power, indicated that several achievements have been made in terms of security, defense, administrative reforms, development and the reconquest of the national territory . Burkina Faso has made rapid progress over the past four years at all levels of development.

article_manifest.title: Crash of the Ouagadougou-Alger flight: Swiftair condemned
article_manifest.original_title: Crash du vol Ouagadougou-Alger: Swiftair condamnée
article_manifest.summary: The families of the victims had to wait twelve years. Gathered within the association "AH-5017 Ensemble", they led a "relentless fight for truth and justice" which is now experiencing its judicial outcome. The Spanish company Swiftair is found guilty of manslaughter this Monday morning by the Paris Criminal Court .
